title: The King Cannot Cross
setup: White's rook on c8 keeps the black king off the c-file and watches the square the d-pawn is heading for.
hint: Nothing of Black's can reach the queening square in time. So what is actually stopping the pawn?
explanation:
## The Idea

The rook on c8 does two jobs at once: it cuts the king off along the c-file and it guards d8. So the pawn simply runs. {{d7}} {{Rh4+}} {{Kg5}} {{Rd4}} {{d8=Q+}} {{Rxd8}} {{Rxd8}} and White is a whole rook up.
